CAP. 256] Protection of Layout Designs
4
CHAPTER 256
106 of 2001. PROTECTION OF LAYOUT DESIGNS (TOPOGRAPHIES) OF
Act 15 of 2000. INTEGRATED CIRCUITS ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER
(Section 29)
[28th July, 2001.]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
PROTECTION OF LAYOUT (cid:150) DESIGNS (TOPOGRAPHIES)
OF INTEGRATED CIRCUITS ACT (COMMENCEMENT)
ORDER.
Commencement 2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by section 29 of the
of Chapter 256. Protection of Layout - Designs (Topographies) of Integrated Circuits Act,
and all other powers thereunto me enabling, I, GODFREY SMITH, Attorney
General, do hereby appoint the 9th day of July, 2001, as the day on which the
said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 9th day of July, 2001.
(GODFREY SMITH)
Attorney General
